items.prompt: For n=4 and pairs [(1,2),(0,2)], why does a min-heap choose 0 before the older ready course 3 after processing 2?

options.text: FIFO order is mandatory for all ready sets.
options.why: The contract requires smallest current index, not longest waiting time.

options.text: Newly ready 0 is smaller than every other ready index.
options.why: Lexicographic choice is over the full current ready set, including new arrivals.

options.text: Every edge must point from a smaller index to a larger one.
options.why: The valid edge 2->0 shows that index direction is unrestricted.

options.text: Course 3 is removed because it has no prerequisites.
options.why: A prerequisite-free course remains eligible; it simply loses this numeric tie.
